C0116.title: Legal Risk Analysis of Click Fraud and Attribution Fraud
C0116.summary: An article by Boss & Young Attorneys-at-Law explains that attribution fraud refers to fraudulent channels exploiting vulnerabilities in third-party attribution strategies by fabricating impressions or clicks to steal credit for user conversions.
